common_technical: Inputs are final daily bars of one ticker in ascending date order (no gaps filled, no zero-filled prehistory). EMA-type averages are seeded with the SMA of their first n valid values; RMA uses alpha 1/n with the same seed. A value is null until its window is full; a zero denominator gives null unless the convention says otherwise. Calculations use the full stored history (price files from 2018) so recursive values match Feature 04.

notes: HTML engine equals TA-Lib.

I04.formula: HMA=WMA(2*WMA(src,floor(n/2))-WMA(src,n), floor(sqrt(n))); each length at least 1
notes: No TA-Lib function; lengths are floored.

I05.formula: ER=ABS(src[t]-src[t-n])/SUM(ABS(src[j]-src[j-1]),n); SC=(ER*(2/(fast+1)-2/(slow+1))+2/(slow+1))^2; KAMA[t]=KAMA[t-1]+SC*(src[t]-KAMA[t-1]); first KAMA seeded with src[n-1]
notes: Equals TA-Lib KAMA at fast=2, slow=30 (TA-Lib fixes them; other values follow the same formula).

I06.formula: macd=EMA(src,fast)-EMA(src,slow); signal=EMA(macd,signal) seeded with the mean of its first valid values; histogram=macd-signal
notes: Built from two SMA-seeded EMAs as Feature 04 does; TA-Lib MACD seeds differently.

I07.formula: +DM/-DM and TR per Wilder; +DI/-DI=100*WilderSum(DM)/WilderSum(TR); DX=100*|+DI--DI|/(+DI+-DI); ADX=Wilder average of DX
notes: TA-Lib Wilder-sum seeding (the HTML RMA seed differed in the first ~120 bars).

I08.formula: AroonUp=100*(n-bars since highest high in the last n+1 bars)/n; AroonDown likewise with the lowest low; ties take the most recent bar
notes: HTML engine equals TA-Lib.

I09.formula: basic bands=HL2±factor*ATR(atr_length) (ATR as I30); final upper band keeps the lower of basic and previous unless the previous close was above it (lower band mirrored); direction flips when close crosses the active band
notes: Uses the TA-Lib ATR of I30.
HTML engine equals TA-Lib.

I11.formula: basis=EMA (or SMA) of src; range=ATR(atr_length) (I30), or TR, or RMA(H-L,length); upper/lower=basis±mult*range
notes: ATR follows I30 (TA-Lib).

I12.formula: Wilder SAR with TA-Lib initialisation (initial direction from the -DM/+DM of the first two bars) and the clamp to the two previous bars; AF starts at start, grows by increment on a new extreme, capped at maximum
notes: Chosen over the HTML/TradingView initialisation (no seeding rule in Wilder); values differed up to 19%.

I13.formula: Wilder RSI: avg gain/loss RMA of the changes; RSI=100-100/(1+gain/loss); 0 when gain and loss are both 0
notes: Flat window gives 0 (TA-Lib), not null.

I14.formula: fastK=100*(RSI-MIN(RSI,m))/(MAX(RSI,m)-MIN(RSI,m)) (0 on a zero range, TA-Lib); K=SMA(fastK,smooth_k); D=SMA(K,smooth_d)
notes: K is smoothed as on charting platforms; TA-Lib STOCHRSI fast %K alone is unsmoothed: do not use it as K.

I15.formula: rawK=100*(C-MIN(L,k))/(MAX(H,k)-MIN(L,k)) (0 on a zero range); K=SMA(rawK,smooth_k); D=SMA(K,d)
notes: This is the slow stochastic; CALC_035/036 describe the fast one.

I19.formula: TP=(H+L+C)/3; CCI=(TP-SMA(TP,n))/(constant*mean absolute deviation of TP from SMA(TP,n))
notes: TA-Lib fixes constant 0.015.
Chande (1994) plain sums, as TradingView and pandas-ta. Do NOT use talib.CMO (Wilder-smoothed); TA-Lib 0.6.8 has no CMOU.
TA-Lib fixes weights 4/2/1.
TA-Lib PPO defaults to SMA (matype 0): pass matype=1.
Ratio 0..1.
Percent: 100 x CALC_051.

I30.formula: TR=MAX(H-L,|H-Cprev|,|L-Cprev|) from the second bar; ATR=Wilder average seeded with the mean of the first n TR
notes: The first bar has no TR (TA-Lib); the HTML used H-L there and differed up to 8.5% in the first year.
Population form.
Population stdev as the HTML engine; CALC_044 uses the sample form.

I37.formula: RVOL=V[t]/SMA(V,n) with the window including t
notes: User 2026-10-25: includes the current bar (as Feature_01.volume_ratio_20d); CALC_062 excludes it.
Seeded with the first bar volume (TA-Lib); the HTML started at 0 (constant offset).

I43.formula: Within each anchor period (Session=one daily bar, Week, Month, Quarter, Year, Decade, Century): VWAP=SUM(src*V)/SUM(V) from the period start; bands ± k*volume-weighted stdev or ± k percent
notes: On daily bars it is not an intraday session VWAP.
TA-Lib seeds its EMAs differently from the SMA seed; equal after warm-up.

I47.formula: TP=(H+L+C)/3; flows=TP*V split by the sign of ΔTP; MFI=100*pos/(pos+neg)

I52.formula: trend=sign(Δ(H+L+C)) (unchanged keeps the previous); dm=H-L; cm accumulates dm while the trend holds; VF=V*|2*(dm/cm-1)|*trend*100; KVO=EMA(VF,fast)-EMA(VF,slow); signal=EMA(KVO,signal)

notes: Williams; not the Money Flow Index.

FL01.formula: Buy BL(C)/BF(C); Sell SL(C)/SF(C) (lots per transaction)

FL02.formula: Buy BV(C)/BF(C); Sell SV(C)/SF(C) (IDR per transaction)

FL03.formula: Buy 100 BL(C)/BL(A); Sell 100 SL(C)/SL(A); A with the same filter

FL04.formula: Buy 100 BF(C)/BF(A); Sell 100 SF(C)/SF(A); A with the same filter

FL05.formula: Buy (BL(C)/BL(A)) / (BF(C)/BF(A)); Sell with SL, SF; A same filter

FL07.formula: 100 BL(C) / BL(A); A: board filter, all investors (default) or board and investor filter

FL08.formula: percentile (baseline) of x = BL(C)/BF(C) (Side Buy) or SL(C)/SF(C) (Sell), window W

FL09.formula: 1 when all hold, else 0 (null when one input is null): FL08 Buy (same cohort, filter, W, baseline) >= pct threshold; FL05 Buy >= ratio threshold; FL07 >= participation threshold; FL11 > net-flow threshold; and, if chosen, FL10 >= imbalance threshold. Drawn as a mark under the candle where 1. Inside FL09, FL07 and FL11 always use the board-only denominator (FL09 has no denominator option)

FL11.formula: 100 (BV(C)-SV(C)) / TBV, TBV = every investor's gross buy on the chosen boards (one denominator, to-do 7); change line (shared conventions)

FL12.formula: 100 x (candles k in the window with BV_k(C)-SV_k(C) > 0) / W; C ranked over the window; a candle without a row of C is not a buy candle

FL13.formula: Buy Σ_(b in C) (m(b)/m(A))^2, m = BL (unit Lot) or BV (Rupiah); Sell with SL/SV; A every broker with the filter; C = every broker (default), selected brokers or Top-N ranked over the window (side picks the cohort)

FL14.formula: FL13 Buy of the top buyers − FL13 Sell of the top sellers (same scope, unit, filter, window; K2)

FL15.formula: 100 x (sum of the N largest m(b)) / m(A), m = BL (unit Lot) or BV (Rupiah); with "minus the even share": - 100 x N'/k, N' = brokers taken, k = brokers with m(b) > 0

FL16.formula: n_b = BV(b)-SV(b) (Rupiah) or BL(b)-SL(b) (Lot, its own sign); 100 x (sum of the N largest positive n_b) / (sum of all positive n_b); with "minus the even share": - 100 x N'/k, k = brokers with n_b > 0

FL17.formula: BV(C) / (100 BL(C)) (IDR per share), on the price axis

FL18.formula: frozen C; sums from the anchor to t: BV(C) / (100 BL(C)); null before the anchor

FL19.formula: frozen C, from the anchor, Q, K start at 0; per candle q = BL_k(C)-SL_k(C): if q > 0: if Q <= 0 then K = max(Q+q,0) x BV_k(C)/BL_k(C) else K += q x BV_k(C)/BL_k(C); if q < 0 and Q > 0: K = K x max(Q+q,0)/Q; then Q += q. Output K/(100 Q) when Q > 0, else null (user 2026-10-30, "1 pakai A": the rule for an inventory at or below 0, which the spreadsheet leaves open)

FL21.formula: percentile (baseline 250) of x = 100 m(C) / TBV, m = net BV-SV (default), gross buy BV or gross sell SV (to-do 10); TBV = every investor's gross buy on the chosen boards

FL22.formula: n_b = BV(b)-SV(b) over the window with the filter; active = brokers with any bv or sv > 0 in it; 100 x (active with n_b > 0) / active; "Number of brokers" (U6): the count of active brokers with n_b > 0

FL23.formula: per chosen broker (and, when "Show cohort total", their sum): from the start candle, Lot: cumulative Σ(bl-sl), Value: cumulative Σ(bv-sv); Daily: the candle's own bl-sl or bv-sv; null before the start. At most 5 brokers are drawn (more are ignored); a code without rows in the data draws 0

FL24.formula: 100 (NB + NS) / TBV(filter); NB = sum of BV-SV of the N bandar buyers, NS = sum of BV-SV (negative) of the N bandar sellers, over the window; TBV(filter) = BV(A) with the filter; reference lines 6, 10, -6, -10

FL26.formula: per candle net n_k = BV_k(C)-SV_k(C) (C ranked over the last limit candles); s_t = s_{t-1}+1 if n_t > 0 and s_{t-1} > 0, 1 if n_t > 0 otherwise; s_{t-1}-1 if n_t < 0 and s_{t-1} < 0, -1 if n_t < 0 otherwise; 0 on a candle with data where n_t = 0 (no row of the cohort or the filter); null on a candle without data, after which the count starts again; capped at ±limit

FL27.formula: 1 when SMA(volume,recent)_t / SMA(volume,baseline)_{t-recent} >= volume x and 100 |close_t/close_{t-recent} - 1| <= max move; drawn as a mark under the candle; and two optional marks (to-do 18), each candle alone, every board and investor: net = 1 when Σ n_b of the N largest net buyers / Σ |n_b| of the N largest net sellers >= X; gross = 1 when Σ bv of the N largest gross buyers / Σ sv of the N largest gross sellers >= X (N, X per trigger; null when the sellers' sum is 0)

FL29.formula: 100 x (candles in the last days whose own one-candle FL24 (N, filter) is above the threshold) / days; a candle without broker data in the window counts as not above; balance (to-do 12) = 100 x Σ_k (NB_k + NS_k) / Σ_k TBV_k over the days, each candle's own bandar, a candle without data adding 0 to both

FL30.formula: 100 BV(Nego+Cash) / BV(all boards), investor filter on both

FL31.formula: sum of insider BUY value minus SELL value with d in the window's candles (IDR); 0 when none

FL32.formula: X_t(A) / mean(X_k(A), k = t-baseline .. t-1), X = transactions BF/SF (default), value BV/SV or lots BL/SL by the measure, Buy or Sell by the side (Both = two lines); filter; null without the full baseline; a candle without broker data inside the baseline adds 0 to the mean (divisor stays baseline); only the transactions measure needs the counts

FL33.formula: 100 ((ΣV/ΣF over the last recent candles) / (ΣV/ΣF over the baseline candles before them) - 1), V, F = the value and transactions of each candle's own cohort C_k (every broker by default; Top-N of that candle: top buyers for Buy, top sellers for Sell, to-do 4); Buy BV/BF, Sell SV/SF; filter

FL34.formula: 100 (BV-SV of the institutional brokers − BV-SV of the retail brokers) / BV(A), filter; defaults: Institutional-heavy and Retail-heavy of ref/brokers; a broker in both lists is refused; change line (shared conventions)

FL35.formula: the broker with the largest positive BV-SV over the window (frozen for that window); 100 x (candles in the window where its BV_k-SV_k > 0) / days; a candle without data counts as not a buy candle; null when no broker has a positive net in the window

FL37.formula: percentile (baseline 250) of BV(C)-SV(C) over the net window; or (U1) its z-score in the same history (shared conventions)

FL38.formula: n_b = BV(b)-SV(b) (Rupiah) or BL(b)-SL(b) (Lot); Σ_(b in C) (max(n_b,0) / Σ positive n)^2; C = every net buyer (default), selected brokers or Top-N (net buy or gross buy) over the window

FL39.formula: 100 (close / FL17 - 1) with FL39's cohort, filter and window; defaults as FL17 (20 candles, every board; to-do 16)

FL40.formula: FL32 Buy spike / FL32 Sell spike, same measure (transactions, value or lots), baseline and filter (default investor Foreign: for all investors it is always 1); reference lines 0.5, 1, 2

FL41.formula: 100 (BV(C)-SV(C)) / (W x mean(TBV_k, k = t-N .. t-1)) over the window W, TBV_k = every investor's gross buy on the chosen boards on candle k (0 without data); null when fewer than N candles precede t since the first data

FL42.formula: Σ_k BV(C_k, k) / (100 Σ_k BL(C_k, k)) over the window, C_k = the N largest net buyers of candle k alone (candles without data skipped); null when a candle with data has fewer than N net buyers

FL43.formula: SV(C) / (100 SL(C)), the cohort, filter and window as FL17

FL44.formula: frozen C as FL18; from the anchor to t: SV(C) / (100 SL(C)); null before the anchor

FL45.formula: 100 (close / FL18 - 1) with FL18's anchor, frozen cohort and filter

FL46.formula: 100 N / D; each side: its measure (gross buy BV, gross sell SV, net buy BV-SV, net sell SV-BV) of its cohort (every broker, selected brokers or Top-N ranked over the window by net buy, net sell, gross buy or gross sell) on its own board and investor filter; one unit for both (Rupiah bv/sv, Lot bl/sl, Transactions bf/sf) and one window; null when D <= 0. Refused: a net measure of every broker over both investor types (always 0), selected brokers without a broker

FL47.formula: 100 Σ_b max(BV(b)-SV(b), 0) / BV(A) over the window (default 5), every broker on the filter; or its percentile in the same history (baseline 252)

FL48.formula: each broker's net n_b = BV(b)-SV(b) over the window first; B = Σ of the N largest positive n_b, S = Σ |n_b| of the N largest negative; (B - S) / (B + S) or B / S; null unless N brokers on each side
